items.title: Publish the canonical status, audit and execution plan
items.acceptance: Current source, historic notes and observed tests are distinguished; findings have evidence and linked work items.

items.title: Build the documentation hub and refresh README
items.acceptance: Pages build passes, local search works, desktop/mobile layouts are checked and private notes stay outside the published tree.

items.title: Capture the existing product
items.acceptance: Real desktop/mobile screenshots use synthetic content and record viewport, source revision and limitations.

items.title: Repair fresh installation and readiness
items.acceptance: On PostgreSQL 16, a clean Compose install applies journal migrations, seeds one admin idempotently and reports unavailable until schema is ready.

items.title: Revoke stale user and admin sessions
items.acceptance: Existing sessions lose privileges after demotion, disablement or deletion; auth integration tests prove both credentials and SSO behaviour.

items.title: Enforce ownership consistently
items.acceptance: Two-user tests reject foreign projects, conversations, files and tool contexts on create, move, chat and realtime routes.

items.title: Validate realtime messages and event identity
items.acceptance: Invalid JSON, roles, IDs and oversized text return 4xx; retries of one provider event produce one persisted message.

items.title: Bound and isolate code execution
items.acceptance: Per-run isolation rejects cross-user files, symlinks, unbounded output and orphan subprocesses in Linux integration tests; no host execution fallback.

items.title: Add database and browser regression CI
items.acceptance: Clean migration, upgrade fixture, seed rerun, two-user auth and chat smoke tests run against real PostgreSQL 16 in CI.

items.title: Propagate cancellation and handle interrupted streams
items.acceptance: Stop or disconnect releases upstream work and tool processes; reconnect cannot duplicate committed messages or charges.

items.title: Add backup, restore and migration release gates
items.acceptance: A disposable restore recovers users, encrypted settings and artifacts; release notes identify backward compatibility and rollback steps.

items.title: Repair seed runtime and developer commands
items.acceptance: Seed runs with supported Node versions and reruns without resetting accounts; lint, typecheck and documented commands have real CI coverage.

items.title: Make logs, errors and health operationally useful
items.acceptance: Request IDs connect API, provider and worker events; secrets are redacted; health separates liveness from DB/worker readiness.

items.title: Create the Polaris design system
items.acceptance: Typography, spacing, colour, focus, surfaces and icon labels work in both themes; screenshot review covers 390, 768 and 1440px.

items.title: Redesign navigation and the home screen
items.acceptance: Projects, chats, tasks and connections have clear destinations; keyboard navigation and empty/loading/error states are tested.

items.title: Refine composer and conversation reading
items.acceptance: Attachments, tool choices, model details, stop/retry, citations and copy controls remain usable at 200% zoom and narrow widths.

items.title: Complete the mobile web interface
items.acceptance: iOS Safari and Android Chrome tests cover virtual keyboard, safe areas, drawers, uploads, long tables, landscape and voice transitions.

items.title: Add an installable PWA
items.acceptance: Manifest, icons and update UX pass install checks; offline screen is honest and authenticated messages are not cached by a generic service worker.

items.title: Add full conversation search and pagination
items.acceptance: Search matches message content with owner filtering; large histories load incrementally and maintain scroll position.

items.title: Add edit, branch, regenerate and compare
items.acceptance: Branch ancestry preserves original messages and usage; failed or retried generations cannot overwrite siblings.

items.title: Improve settings and administration on mobile
items.acceptance: Provider, model, user/group and usage screens work at 390px with labelled inputs and no page-wide horizontal overflow.

items.title: Improve artifacts and accessible previews
items.acceptance: Preview, source, version history and download work for code, HTML and files; executable previews are isolated and usable on small screens.

items.title: Refresh screenshots and user guides
items.acceptance: Versioned screenshots come from deterministic demo fixtures and show new behaviour without credentials or real conversations.

items.title: Create a versioned provider capability registry
items.acceptance: Model snapshots define modalities, tools, reasoning, limits and parameter support; unknown IDs require explicit configuration instead of guessed support.

items.title: Update SDKs and Responses contracts
items.acceptance: Recorded streaming fixtures cover text, reasoning summaries, refusal, tool calls, citations, artifacts, cancellation and schema evolution.

items.title: Unify context and retention policy
items.acceptance: Projects, memory, attachments and tool results use one context builder across chat/voice/jobs; retention and remote deletion are explicitly tested.

items.title: Integrate provider compaction and token budgets
items.acceptance: Long sessions retain required tool pairs and instructions; opaque compaction state is preserved and token estimates do not silently truncate user instructions.

items.title: Track actual usage and model retirement
items.acceptance: Unknown pricing displays unknown; cached/reasoning/audio/tool/container usage is separate; dated price sources and retirement notices drive admin alerts.

items.title: Finish native search, retrieval and structured outputs
items.acceptance: Citations open the correct source, retrieval respects owner boundaries and structured results validate against declared schemas.

items.title: Modernise image generation and editing
items.acceptance: Image inputs, masks where supported, variations, partial/final events and artifact download use supported model contracts and explicit usage limits.

items.title: Add long research and document analysis
items.acceptance: Multi-step research resumes after restart, preserves source citations and produces downloadable reports with evidence of tool failures.

items.title: Refactor voice into testable session states
items.acceptance: Connecting, listening, speaking, interrupted, reconnecting and ended states have deterministic event tests and accessible controls.

items.title: Share context and tool permissions with voice
items.acceptance: Voice receives the selected project/model context and cannot invoke tools outside the same effective policy as text chat.

items.title: Handle duplex speech, interruptions and reconnects
items.acceptance: Mock event replay and an opt-in real WebRTC test cover barge-in, echo, mute, route changes, reconnect and transcript ordering.

items.title: Evaluate GPT-Live alongside Realtime
items.acceptance: An ADR compares latency, delegation, tool controls, model support, retention and duration costs; adapters expose one UI contract.

items.title: Add voice metering and audio model migrations
items.acceptance: Session duration caps, usage reconciliation and idle shutdown work; deprecated transcription/TTS paths have tested replacements.

items.title: Enable optional screen, camera and file context
items.acceptance: Users explicitly share and stop each source; permissions denied and revoked states work without retaining unintended media.

items.title: Create scoped user API keys
items.acceptance: Keys are random, hashed at rest, revealed once, scoped and expiring; rotate/revoke and owner restrictions pass negative tests.

items.title: Ship a versioned API and OpenAPI specification
items.acceptance: Models and streaming chat endpoints have schema validation, request IDs and documented error/cancellation semantics; compatibility scope is explicit.

items.title: Apply API quotas and audit trails
items.acceptance: Per-key/user rate and spend limits are enforced under concurrent requests; logs exclude bearer secrets and sensitive message bodies by default.

items.title: Add SDK examples and a key management UI
items.acceptance: Copyable curl, Python and TypeScript examples pass against a disposable server; users can see usage and revoke a key.

items.title: Build a credential vault and connector registry
items.acceptance: Encrypted credentials are referenced by ID with owner, scope and expiry; rotation and disconnect revoke access without exposing secrets in exports.

items.title: Implement a versioned pipeline runtime
items.acceptance: Model, tool, transform, branch, bounded parallel, approval and output nodes validate a versioned DAG and emit trace events; cycles and resource overruns fail clearly.

items.title: Build a visual pipeline editor
items.acceptance: Users can create, validate, dry-run, inspect, version and roll back a workflow; JSON import/export round-trips without credentials.

items.title: Support OpenWebUI-style extension contracts
items.acceptance: Documented Pipe/Filter/Action/Event semantics and Valves/UserValves examples pass conformance fixtures; unsupported Python plugins are rejected honestly.

items.title: Complete MCP protocol support
items.acceptance: Pinned stable protocol, initialize, discovery, schemas, transport/session handling, cancellation and reconnect interoperate with two real test servers.

items.title: Repair custom functions and add OpenAPI tools
items.acceptance: Model IDs are distinct from response IDs; webhook and OpenAPI inputs/outputs validate, secrets remain server-side and endpoint policy survives DNS redirects.

items.title: Add a reviewed template and extension library
items.acceptance: Templates declare version, permissions, credentials, resource needs and tests; install/update/disable has an audit trail.

items.title: Create durable runs and a separate worker
items.acceptance: A run survives web/worker restart with persisted cursor, attempts, leases and checkpoints; duplicate delivery never duplicates external effects.

items.title: Add schedules and event triggers
items.acceptance: Timezone, DST, missed schedules, retries and overlapping runs have explicit policy and integration tests; inactive users cannot start work.

items.title: Build task progress, steering and approvals
items.acceptance: Users can inspect evidence, pause/cancel, add context and approve a concrete external action; stale approvals cannot authorize changed payloads. Rule creation/edit/delete, precedence and distinct run/schedule/proactivity stop scopes are tested.

items.title: Enforce run budgets and concurrency
items.acceptance: Step, duration, token, tool, container and daily spend ceilings stop work predictably; reservations reconcile on failure.

items.title: Add persistent assistant identity and memory
items.acceptance: User-controlled memory provenance, project boundaries, inspect/edit/forget and temporary mode persist consistently across supported channels.

items.title: Add proactive updates and notifications
items.acceptance: Quiet hours, opt-in channels, meaningful-change suppression and delivery retries avoid duplicate or noisy updates.

items.title: Evaluate the managed Agents API
items.acceptance: A time/cost-bounded spike compares managed and self-hosted execution, data location, retention, artifacts and recovery; documented eligibility gates choose the adapter.

items.title: Define interchangeable execution providers
items.acceptance: Local isolated worker and one cloud provider implement the same job/artifact contract with owner isolation and explicit resource ceilings.

items.title: Add cloud compute workspaces
items.acceptance: Run-scoped files, package installation, expiry, snapshots and artifact export survive reconnect and are deleted on expiry; quota tests include failure paths.

items.title: Add isolated browser sessions
items.acceptance: Per-user browser state, live preview, sign-in handoff, domain policy, idle shutdown and cleanup work without sharing cookies between users.

items.title: Add computer-use action controls
items.acceptance: External page instructions cannot widen permissions; submissions/purchases require the user's applicable action policy and concrete review when needed. Watching, human takeover, agent return-control and access revocation have distinct verified effects.

items.title: Add deployable artifact previews
items.acceptance: Preview URLs expire, artifacts carry provenance, credentials never enter public bundles and users can export reproducible source.

items.title: Add cloud operations and cost visibility
items.acceptance: Orphan resources are reconciled, expiry is enforced after worker crashes and actual compute/browser usage appears per user/run.

items.title: Build OAuth, webhooks and sync infrastructure
items.acceptance: OAuth state/PKCE, refresh races, webhook signature/replay checks, subscription renewal and idempotent delta cursors pass provider fixtures.

items.title: Add Microsoft 365 mail and calendar
items.acceptance: Graph delegated read/search, drafts and calendar operations pass against a test tenant; send/write scopes are separate and admin consent is documented.

items.title: Add Teams conversations and notifications
items.acceptance: Bot installation and supported Graph permissions are tested in a tenant; no migration-only permission is used as a general send-as-user mechanism.

items.title: Add Gmail and Google Calendar
items.acceptance: Read/search, drafts, opted-in sends and calendar sync handle token revocation and quota errors; required verification is complete before general release.

items.title: Add Telegram as an assistant channel
items.acceptance: A one-time account linking flow binds bot chat to the correct user; webhook secrets, duplicate updates and unlink are tested.

items.title: Add Discord commands and conversations
items.acceptance: OAuth bot install, guild/channel allowlists, interaction verification and per-user linking work; required intents are documented.

items.title: Validate and add WhatsApp business messaging
items.acceptance: Confirm current Meta eligibility and messaging rules first; official test-number webhooks, templates and opt-outs pass before enabling real delivery.

items.title: Add iCloud Mail
items.acceptance: IMAP/SMTP credential handling, folder sync, reconnect and revocation pass with a dedicated test mailbox; primary Apple passwords are never stored.

items.title: Validate and add iCloud Calendar
items.acceptance: Prove supported authorization and CalDAV discovery/ETag sync with a test account; recurrence, timezone and conflicting writes have fixtures.

items.title: Add OneDrive, SharePoint and Google Drive retrieval
items.acceptance: Indexing preserves source ACLs, deletions and citations; revoked permissions promptly remove accessible content.

items.title: Add a connections centre and action ledger
items.acceptance: Users inspect permissions, last sync, actions and errors, disconnect accounts and separately enable reads, drafts and sends.

items.title: Add share links and workspace collaboration
items.acceptance: Explicit access modes, expiry, revoke and redaction work; shared links never leak private files, system instructions or other users' memory.

items.title: Add custom assistants and reusable skills
items.acceptance: Assistants package instructions, models, skills, knowledge and allowed tools; versioning and publish/install permissions are enforced.

items.title: Add portable import, export and deletion
items.acceptance: Account export contains portable chats/files/configuration without credentials; deletion reconciles local and provider-side resources and reports failures.

items.title: Add feedback and evaluation suites
items.acceptance: Versioned golden tasks measure grounded answers, tool choice, refusal, latency and cost; releases compare against a recorded baseline.

items.title: Add multimodal feature parity spikes
items.acceptance: Screen/video, richer canvas editing and document authoring each have an API feasibility and cost experiment before becoming release commitments.

items.title: Add localisation and accessibility release gates
items.acceptance: Key journeys pass keyboard/screen-reader review, WCAG-oriented automated checks, RTL layout and translated string coverage.

items.title: Prepare the first supported platform release
items.acceptance: Version tag, changelog, migration/restore rehearsal, dependency review, load tests and support matrix identify every supported and experimental capability.

items.title: Customise the Polaris Pal companion
items.acceptance: Appearance persists per user; shape, colour, eyes and accessories render on mobile and desktop, with keyboard labels and reduced-motion support.

items.title: Build the Pal home and workspace shell
items.acceptance: Owned activity, attention and computer surfaces have useful empty states; disconnected tools never pretend to execute tasks; mobile navigation is verified.

items.title: Talk to Pal while delegated work continues
items.acceptance: A synthetic voice call can inspect, steer and stop a separate durable run without blocking speech or losing task context after a tab reconnect.

items.title: Build an attention inbox and notification controls
items.acceptance: Important findings have evidence and deduplicated delivery; urgency, quiet hours, snooze and per-responsibility unsubscribe are tested with synthetic events.

items.title: Add natural wake, sleep and responsibility controls
items.acceptance: Saved responsibilities record timezone, sources, permissions, budget and notification rule; stopping a current run and cancelling future occurrences have distinct tested effects.

items.title: Add private sign-in and explicit control handoff
items.acceptance: Credentials remain outside model-visible events; private browser sign-in, session expiry, sign-out and return-control are tested without recording secrets. Optional saved logins require explicit confirmation before reuse.

items.title: Preserve Pal identity across audience-bound channels
items.acceptance: One assistant retains relevant private notes across connected channels while authorization tests prevent disclosure into a different user or group audience.

items.title: Expose saved notes and memory provenance
items.acceptance: Users can inspect, edit, delete and export saved assistant notes; source and audience are visible and deleted notes stop entering subsequent context.

items.title: Run an isolated local computer provider
items.acceptance: A per-workspace Linux container or VM runs on the local host with no host-shell fallback, scoped mounts, credential separation, resource caps and verified teardown.

items.title: Watch and take over the local browser
items.acceptance: Chrome/Chromium tabs and a live view are owner-authenticated; two-client tests prove exclusive input lease, agent pause on takeover and fresh observation after return-control.

items.title: Add a visible interactive terminal
items.acceptance: PTY output, input, resize, interrupt and reconnect work only in the owned isolated workspace; output backpressure and process-tree cleanup are verified.

items.title: Add a workspace file explorer and editor
items.acceptance: Owned directory listing, preview, edit, upload and download reject symlink traversal, cross-user references, oversized files and stale overwrite versions.

items.title: Pilot a pinned local Codex runtime adapter
items.acceptance: A disabled-by-default adapter pins App Server protocol/schema and tests handshake, resume, steer, cancel and approvals; experimental support and production release decision are explicit.

items.title: Stream accessible charts and tables into chat
items.acceptance: Validated chart/table specs update incrementally with source links and export; malicious specs never execute application-origin script and mobile/keyboard fallbacks are tested.

items.title: Evaluate Decisions for bounded routing and urgency
items.acceptance: Predicate/choice/score contracts are tested on synthetic cases, cost and uncertainty are recorded, and model outputs cannot override deterministic permissions or spending limits.

items.title: Add Slack as a Pal messaging channel
items.acceptance: OAuth scopes, direct messages, audience separation, webhook replay and revoke tests pass with a dedicated Slack test workspace.

items.title: Evaluate supported phone channels and iMessage feasibility
items.acceptance: Document supported RCS/SMS provider contracts, identity verification and geography; identify any missing public iMessage API explicitly and never advertise unsupported parity.

items.title: Add native iOS widget and shortcut entrypoints
items.acceptance: A supported native integration can open or start an authorized Pal interaction from widget, Shortcuts and Action button; account consent, deep links and device tests are recorded.

items.title: Add opt-in read-only proactive research
items.acceptance: User-selected read scopes produce attributed private findings; tests prove research cannot write connected services, control computers or create monitoring subscriptions by itself.

items.title: Pair a personal-computer bridge with explicit access grants
items.acceptance: Pairing binds one user and device, narrowly scoped folders/apps, authenticated heartbeat and immediate revocation; it grants no implicit access to personal browser sessions or unrelated chats. Browser-history access requires its own visible opt-in grant and revocation path.

items.title: Import and generate animated companion assets
items.acceptance: Custom companions have a validated versioned sprite/asset format, bounded uploads, accessible state labels, reduced-motion fallback and ownership; generation/editing is tested with current image APIs.

items.title: Add native document, sheet, slide and LaTeX artifact editing
items.acceptance: Supported document/spreadsheet/presentation/LaTeX formats have editable state, previews, version history and export; formulas, malformed files, cross-user access and delivery are tested separately.

items.title: Integrate GitHub work and review evidence
items.acceptance: Repository-scoped access supports issues, branches, PRs and check results with explicit write authority, idempotent submission and reviewable test/video artifacts; credentials never enter task logs.
